desc_zh: 几乎全暗，只有轮廓与局部高光，压迫、神秘、藏信息
desc_en: Almost entirely dark, only rim light and small highlights; oppressive and mysterious

desc_zh: 主体压成近乎纯黑的剪影，背景保留微光，强调轮廓与姿态
desc_en: Subject nearly pure black silhouette against faint background light; shape and pose first

desc_zh: 几乎没有硬边，雾面柔光，明暗过渡绵密，适合回忆与梦境
desc_en: No hard edges, misty soft light, dense tonal transitions; memory and dream

desc_zh: 刀切式明暗分界，硬边投影，黑白几乎直接相接
desc_en: Knife-edge light division, hard cast shadows, near-binary black and white

desc_zh: 青灰雾面，冷光穿透，空气有湿度与距离感
desc_en: Blue-grey mist, cold light cutting through, humid air and distance

desc_zh: 米金雾面，暖光漫射，柔和但有颗粒
desc_en: Cream-gold mist, diffused warm light, soft but grainy

desc_zh: 湿冷反光、雨幕与积水倒影，暗部偏青蓝
desc_en: Wet cold reflections, rain veils and puddles, blue-green shadows

desc_zh: 蓝银月光，深蓝暗部，轮廓清楚但细节少
desc_en: Blue-silver moonlight, deep blue shadows, clear silhouette but sparse detail

desc_zh: 青品红霓虹、湿街反光、彩色边缘光，赛博/夜城
desc_en: Cyan-magenta neon, wet street reflections, colored rim light; cyber night city

desc_zh: 橙黄局部光，大面积黑，光源小且不稳定，旧时代室内
desc_en: Small flickering amber light, vast darkness; old interior

desc_zh: 低角度暖白晨光，长影，空气清透
desc_en: Low warm-white morning light, long shadows, clear air

desc_zh: 金橙余晖，紫灰暗部，轮廓被暖边光勾出
desc_en: Golden-orange afterglow, purple-grey shadows, warm rim light

desc_zh: 均匀灰光，低对比，没有明确投影，冷清写实
desc_en: Even grey light, low contrast, no clear shadows; cold realism

desc_zh: 钨丝灯暖黄，暗角明显，墙面与皮肤偏橙
desc_en: Tungsten warmth, strong vignette, orange skin and walls

desc_zh: 光源在主体背后，边缘光清楚，背景局部过曝
desc_en: Light behind subject, clear rim, blown background highlights

desc_zh: 单侧轮廓光，明暗分界沿鼻梁/肩线切开
desc_en: One-sided rim light, tonal division along nose bridge and shoulder

desc_zh: 顶光压眼，眼窝与下颌投影重，审讯/恐怖感
desc_en: Overhead light pressing the eyes, heavy eye-socket and jaw shadows; interrogation

desc_zh: 从下往上打光，面部阴影反转，诡异、非自然
desc_en: Light from below, inverted facial shadows; eerie and unnatural

desc_zh: 四分之三侧光，暗侧脸颊出现三角光，古典肖像
desc_en: Three-quarter key, triangle of light on the shadow cheek; classical portrait

desc_zh: 只亮主体或关键物件，环境沉入黑，强指向性
desc_en: Only subject or key object lit, environment sinks into black; strongly directional

desc_zh: 低饱和暖灰，黑位抬升，像旧照片/旧印刷
desc_en: Desaturated warm grey, lifted blacks; old photo or old print

desc_zh: 高颗粒胶片，粗粝边缘，暗部有噪点但结构清楚
desc_en: Heavy film grain, coarse edges, noisy shadows with clear structure

desc_zh: 颜色克制、灰调为主，只保留一个重点色
desc_en: Restrained greyish palette with one accent color

desc_zh: 高纯度、强对比，波普/海报式色彩，适合喜剧与冲击画面
desc_en: High purity, strong contrast, pop/poster color; comedy and impact
